ns2:section.sectionText: This section will open to Information Systems major students on Monday, April 15, 2019 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This section will open to Finance, Accountancy, Operations Management, Marketing, Supply Chain Management MSF, PMBA, MBA, MSM, MSBA, MSTM and Industrial & Enterprise Systems Engineering, General Engineering and Systems Engineering & Design students on Monday, April 22, 2019 at approximately 10:00 a.m. There are currently 10 seats reserved for Gies College of Business international exchange students only (any exchange students outside of GCOB who try to register will be removed); any unused seats will be released to students meeting the restrictions on Friday, August 30, 2019 at approximately 10:00 a.m.
